review.editorial: Separate complete Chinese review checked movement, viewpoint, dialogue voices, scene rhythm and time bridges; revised an awkward action and reread fixed scene. Full companion English reviewed and refined before encoding was finalized.
review.continuity_or_facts: Compared prior actual ending, checkpoint and relevant earlier prose. Tracked possessions, injuries, limits of knowledge, passage of time and ordinary consequences. Previous-to-current reader transition inspected; no unexplained recovery or information transfer.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed all 86 clause/sentence units and 725 chunks for natural faithful English, lexical coverage and distinct spans. Source reproduced exactly; deterministic output validates without warnings. Focused contextual pronunciation and mapped slices checked with counterexamples. Saved sentence and Listen source units inspected without speech.

Phone Chinese middle viewed: dialogue turns and paragraph flow intact, normal page break within continuing speech.

Focused phone pinyin passage viewed: dialogue attribution and longer descriptive clauses maintain readable wrapping and guides.
